metadata.question: Between September through November 2021, did Seattle experience at least 40cm of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) – global rainfall, no clouds to mask. - Date: 2021-09-01 → 2021-11-30 (inclusive). - Location: Seattle – a point around downtown (~ -122.33, 47.61) is enough; CHIRPS is 5 km so small polygon vs point makes little difference. 2. Masking: None needed – precipitation band is always valid (no clouds). 3. Logic: - Sum total precipitation over the three months. - 40 cm = 400 mm. - If sum ≥ 400 mm → “A: Yes”; else → “B: No”. - If collection size is 0 → C1; if reducer returns None/NaN → C3 (extremely unlikely for CHIRPS). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time seattle = ee.Geometry.Point(-122.3321, 47.6062) start, end = '2021-09-01', '2021-11-30' # 2. Data acquisition col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterDate(start, end) \ .filterBounds(seattle) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No images found.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Total rainfall (mm) total = col.sum().multiply(1) \ .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=seattle, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9) \ .get('precipitation') \ .getInfo() if total is None: print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") exit() print(f"Total rainfall: {total:.1f} mm (Images: {n})") # 4. Answer print("A" if total >= 400 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
seattle = ee.Geometry.Point(-122.3321, 47.6062)
start, end = '2021-09-01', '2021-11-30'

# 2. Data acquisition
col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
        .filterDate(start, end) \
        .filterBounds(seattle)
n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No images found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Total rainfall (mm)
total = col.sum().multiply(1) \
          .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
                        geometry=seattle,
                        scale=5000,
                        maxPixels=1e9) \
          .get('precipitation') \
          .getInfo()

if total is None:
    print("Calculation failed.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

print(f"Total rainfall: {total:.1f} mm (Images: {n})")

# 4. Answer
print("<answer>A</answer>" if total >= 400 else "<answer>B</answer>")
